head: 7f44a537ed98
scope: Protection, au niveau des propriétaires non visuels, des six comportements de suppression de personnage qui n'étaient plus protégés que par des tests d'UI retirée.

testFile.path_driven: AuthoringResourceFixture réelle sur disque, runCharacterRemoval, CharacterRemovalController, ResourceNavigation.prepareOperation/applyPrepared et MapWorkspaceController.restore ; aucune interface.

replaces.redTest: character_removal_resolution_host_test : dirty owner blocks inspection and keeps focused input
replaces.newTest: a dirty draft of the removed character refuses inspection and keeps the draft

replaces.redTest: character_removal_concurrency_host_test : dirty replacement is refused without saving its focused draft
replaces.newTest: a dirty draft of the replacement refuses the replace resolution and keeps the map reference

replaces.redTest: character_removal_resolution_host_test : affected dirty map refuses removal without saving another owner
replaces.newTest: a dirty map that references the character refuses removal and saves nothing

replaces.redTest: character_removal_resolution_host_test : unrelated dirty map does not block a free character removal
replaces.newTest: a dirty map without the character does not block removal and stays dirty

replaces.redTest: character_removal_resolution_host_test : free removal preserves an unrelated focused character draft
replaces.newTest: a removal drops only the removed draft and keeps another dirty draft

replaces.redTest: character_removal_history_host_test : replacement preserves unrelated undo and rejects deleted NPC
replaces.newTest: a replacement keeps the open map history and refuses an undo to the deleted character

commands.command: Quatre mutations ciblées appliquées une à une dans une copie git archive HEAD sous AveluneQA, code restauré à l'identique après chaque essai, copie supprimée.
commands.result: guard_off : 3 rouges ; guard_all_maps : 3 rouges ; reconcile_all : 1 rouge ; history_off : 1 rouge.

notDone: Les 16 tests hôtes character_removal_* rouges ne sont ni retirés ni réécrits ; leur retrait relève d'une décision et du registre retiredUiChecks.
Les 10 cas partiellement couverts (réconciliation d'une carte ouverte propre via acceptResourceContent, retrait réussi d'un brouillon de bordure, stock d'objets de combat…) restent à protéger.
